checks.name: default-off refresh leaves existing login unchanged and cannot create a family
invalid gate or missing dedicated key fails closed before login without cookies
actual router login issues both cookies and unchanged original principal without bearer JSON
actual router refresh and old-parent retry produce same successor and persisted session
context-protected actual lesson and progress persist with stable UUID and idempotent retry
old learning context cannot complete the next lesson after another native family logs in
actual router enforces origin and body integrity before changing refresh generation
actual default logout revokes family and global version; retry cannot revoke subsequent login
actual local logout retry preserves newer cookies and sessions
actual password writer revokes families, clears both cookies and requires new login
expired one-hour access refreshes before ALS-render boundary using a synthetic fresh Source mirror
actual refresh-only global logout keeps scope, creates no intermediate session and retries without clearing newer login
actual rendered context rejects stale form after new login without revoking current identity
pending Source authority returns outage without guest redirect or clearing native cookies

scope: Actual native-stage-router, ALS native lesson reader, publication guard and real workerd/D1; synthetic principals/course only
limitations: No hosted deploy/browser/full vinext SSR/original customer lesson/video/legacy session adoption/native primary authority; simulated clock and synthetic Source readiness only
